pay_detail: At least the state minimum wage; hours and pay vary by site
duration: 6 to 8 weeks in summer; a year-round option runs September to May
name: YouthWorks
org: Commonwealth Corporation, with local MassHire workforce boards
what_you_do: Work a paid summer or school year job at a public, private or nonprofit site. You also take paid job training in skills like talking and leading.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 25 with family income at or under 200% of the federal poverty line. You also need at least one listed factor. Examples are one income in the home, being a person of color, a disability, no stable home, or leaving school. Apply through the program in your town.
deadline_text: No youth deadline is posted. Local programs set their own dates. Summer 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Find your town on the 'Find a YouthWorks Program Near You' list, then contact that local workforce board program.
notes: Each local program picks its own jobs and dates. Seats are limited. Whether a Massachusetts work permit is needed was not stated on these pages; ask the local program.
